    if plan.exists():
        d=json.loads(plan.read_text()); t=p/d['file']; c=d['content'].replace(chr(123)+'task'+chr(125),k)
    else:
        t=p/f; prev=t.read_text() if t.exists() else ''; c=prev+'def change_%d():\n    return %r\n' % (len(prev.splitlines()),k)

    subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(p),'add','-A'],check=True,env=e,capture_output=True)
